visual_action: A montage of still images representing Midwestern life, including rural landscapes with a rainbow, deep-dish pizza, a small town street, a diner breakfast, and an American flag hanging on a wall. Interspersed are photos of Democratic politicians: Gretchen Whitmer signing a bill, Pete Buttigieg speaking, Tammy Duckworth at a lectern, Tammy Baldwin speaking outdoors, and J.B. Pritzker waving at a parade. The text "midwest democrats 💙" is overlaid on every image.

audio_music: The song 'Fast Car' by Tracy Chapman plays throughout the video. It has a nostalgic, warm, and heartfelt acoustic feel, contributing to a sense of reminiscence and belonging.

central_claim: Midwest Democrats are an authentic and integral part of the wholesome, everyday life and values of the American heartland.
intended_effect: To create a positive, nostalgic, and emotional association between viewers and the Democratic Party in the Midwest, portraying it as relatable and grounded.
